{{Quote|I thought only the Jedi possessed such weapons!|[[Reess Kairn]] to [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]|<ref name="The Bounty Hunters: Aurra Sing">''[[The Bounty Hunters: Aurra Sing]]''</ref>}}
The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] had a [[Color/Legends|scarlet]]-bladed '''lightsaber'''. Sing didn't construct the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] herself, but took it from one of the Jedi she killed.

==History==
===Before the Clone Wars===
Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Sing used it to kill [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mana Veridi]] on the planet [[Kwannot]] and later wielded it in combat against [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Sing carried her lightsaber while on the search for the rogue Jedi [[Reess Kairn]].

===During the Clone Wars===
Three months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Aurra Sing wielded a second lightsaber alongside her original. She used her lightsabers to fend off [[Smart mine/Legends|smart mines]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Old Scores">{{CWACite|8|Old Scores}}</ref>

===The Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|You handle a lightsaber pretty well, prey. Where did you get that?"<br>"An acquaintance sent it to me. I guess he didn't want it anymore.|Aurra Sing and [[Jax Pavan]] on Jax using Sing's red lightsaber|<ref name="CNII:SOS" />}}
Several months after the rise of the Empire, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] freed Aurra Sing from the prison world of [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]] to find the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]]. Meeting Vader in the lower levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for a meeting, Aurra initially drew her lightsaber on Vader, unsure as to who or what was there. Vader, however, used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] Sing's weapon from her hand and into his own. Then curiously, the blade kept getting brighter to the point where Aurra could only see Vader, and the hum rose in pitch. The lightsaber then shut off, its [[Energy crystal|energy crystal]] having been overloaded. After that, Vader dropped the now useless weapon to the ground. Aurra noted that while she was well versed in weaponry she had never seen anything like that before.<ref name="CNII:SOS" />

Though her lightsaber was still usable as when she was investigating the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for information of Jax Pavan she came across [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]]. Typho was able to disarm her of her lightsaber, and Sing then engaged Typho in a lightsaber duel with a [[Aurra Sing's green lightsaber|green lightsaber]]. Typho was barely able to win the battle when he struck her [[Biocomputer/Legends|skull implant]], leaving the bounty hunter unconscious. Typho took the red lightsaber with him as he fled the temple.<ref name="CNII:SOS" />

Captain Typho later gave the lightsaber to a delivery [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to deliver to Jax Pavan before Typho went to speak with and shorter after confront Darth Vader. Jax and his friends were initially confused but Jax accepted the package. Typho left a note in the package reading that a Jedi was deserving of a more suitable than a [[Jax Pavan's Velmorian energy sword|Velmorian energy sword]] and signed it a 'fellow revolutionary.' Jax kept the lightsaber on him and used it at a construction access way at [[Spaceport Nine]] to duel Aurra Sing, who fought him with her emerald lightsaber. Sing was determined to get the lightsaber back, even if it meant violating Vader's terms of capturing Jax and alive. Jax was barely able to keep up with Sing's relentless attacks due to the Force aiding him. He attempted to tire her out, but realized her stamina was greater than his and he was already beginning to get tired. He resorted to outsmarting her, jumping up onto a fabber. He anticipated that Aurra Sing would land on the fabber's safety field that stopped things from falling into the bin that churned sand. When Sing landed, Jax hit the button with his foot, causing the bounty hunter to fall in and quickly become engulfed by the swirling sand.<ref name="CNII:SOS" />

Some months after Jax drew the lightsaber again when he watched [[Kajin Savaros]] [[Duel near Ploughtekal Market|battling]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Probus Tesla]]. Though Jax kept behind cover until Kajin fell beside him after being knocked off his feet by the sound of a blast of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] from the Inquisitor hitting the repulsor field. The lightning also left Tesla unconscious. As Jax and Laranth Tarak helped Kajin escape, Savaros questioned whether Jax was really a Jedi or not given his lightsaber was red and that Laranth didn't use a lightsaber. Laranth explained she was a [[Gray Paladin]] and they had a different philosphy to weapons and Jax explained his original [[Jax Pavan's lightsaber|lightsaber]] was destroyed and was gifted his current blade.<ref name="CNIII:POF">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>

Jax later used the lightsaber to [[Duel at Rainbow Parkway and Gallery Row|fight]] the Inquisitioner [[Yral Chael]]. Jax severed the truth officer's leg and [[I-5YQ]] finished him off.<ref name="CNIII:POF" />

Jax used the lightsaber again to try and strike down Vader after he used the [[Bota/Legends|bota]] extract. Tesla got in the way and engaged him in a short duel that almost killed Pavan. Once Tesla was hurled away by Vader's uncontrollable Force blasts, Jax tried to striked at Vader's Force cocoon only to be flung back.<ref name="CNIII:POF" />

Jax eventually stopped using the lightsaber when he finished another [[Jax Pavan’s third lightsaber|lightsaber]]. Though he still kept the Sith blade on him. Following the [[Ambush near the Twins|confrontation]] at the [[Twins (star system)/Legends|Twins]], the Sith lightsaber was among some of the few possessions Jax still had, including his clothing, third lightsaber, [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith Holocron]] [[SD41263.I]], a [[pyronium]] nugget and one of Laranth Tarak's blasters.<ref name="TLJ" />

When Jax Pavan, [[Den Dhur]] and I-5YQ acquired a new ship, the [[Laranth]], Jax hid the Sith lightsaber in the ship's feeding container for his miisai tree. Jax later released a [[Force scream/Legends|Force scream]] that hurled around items in his quarters in the Laranth including the container, causing the miisai tree roots to be exposed and crushed by the broken feeding container. The Sith lightsaber sat next to the broken container, which Jax viewed as the lightsaber taunting him.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Description==
According to Jax Pavan, the lightsaber's hilt was elegantly simple, consisting of an ambidextrous grip of molded silver duralumin. It also had a locking activator similar to Pavan's previous lightsaber<ref name="CNII:SOS" /> which allowed the lightsaber's blade to stay on when not being held.<ref name="CNI:JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> The blade was red.<ref name="SW10" />
